fixer.title: Engineering - Rerun failed tests in isolation and split integration CI steps

introducer.title: Engineering - enable automatic retries for failed Electron unit test files

cases.mechanism: A single flaky test caused every test in each affected file to execute again in a fresh Electron window on every retry, repeating already-successful test work in proportion to file size.
cases.symptom: Retry latency and CI resource use grew with all tests contained in failed files rather than with the actual failed tests; PR CI performs up to two retries.
cases.fixedBehavior: The rerun plan now builds a title grep for up to 50 failed tests or failed-hook suites, so the fresh Electron window loads the required files but executes only the unresolved targets, retaining whole-file fallback for unsupported or broad cases.
cases.evidence: Base line 650, introduced by commit 0b9c9384fcec8f929335c8a95380e55f756c9465, constructed the next run from every failed file. The changed planner at line 756 creates a grep from deduplicated failed test/suite titles and passes it to the next window, directly removing execution of successful sibling tests for ordinary flaky failures.
